summary.intent: Execute all remaining plans of GSD phase 68.1 (web-client-runtime-integration) for CipherBox — wiring the v2.0 web app onto the node/v3 read+write chain until the full web-e2e suite passes — through multiple gap-closure rounds driven by live user bug reports, then note deferrals and ship the phase via /ship-phase 68.1.
summary.outcome: Phase 68.1 reached verification 'passed' 5/5 (commit 643f1b182) after 33 plans and 4 e2e rounds (11→2 failures, exactly the two approved deferrals); user then kicked off /ship-phase 68.1, which got through verify/secure/validate/simplify/SDK-E2E/CodeRabbit stages, capturing several defer-class todos, before the transcript ends mid-ship (PR/reword/resolve-reviews steps not yet reached).

repo: CipherBox write-plane bugs cluster around WriteChildRef handling: cold-load never populated FolderState.writeKey (fixed via recoverWriteKeyIfNeeded), batch uploadFiles never inserted WriteChildRefs, SharedFolderTree cloned a zeroed writeKey, and moveItem never re-homed the WriteChildRef from source to dest write-body (client.ts ~1669-1810) — same bug class recurs at every write-plane call site added since phase 62's node/v3 migration.
WriteChildRef must always be keyed by the resolved node UUID (childPub.id), never by moveItem's ipnsName-based childId param — a planner explicitly caught this trap before execution.

D-02 kind-cache async race exists at multiple projection sinks independently: folder.store.ts SDK-event handler, useFileBrowserActions.ts handleSync, and folder-helpers.ts resyncFolder all needed the same resolve-before-insert fix (68.1-33).

mock-ipns-routing dev container's healthcheck used busybox wget against 'localhost' which resolves to ::1, but the app only binds IPv4 — false 'unhealthy' status; fix is 127.0.0.1 in docker-compose.yml.

tests/web-e2e specs use describe.serial per file, so one early failure cascades and skips the rest of that file — failure counts understate real breakage until specs are fixed and re-run to completion.

Local E2E requires TEST_LOGIN_SECRET and DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL env vars aligned between API and Playwright harness, plus fresh sdk-core/sdk dist rebuilds before every gate run — .env files are permission-denied to read directly, must use env var overrides instead.

GAP-6: the shares.item_name plaintext column was fully dropped by migration 1750000000000-ApiSchemaCutover, making the REQ-4 backfill feature permanently dead code; an EncryptShareItemName migration already existed server-side, suggesting the encrypted redesign was half-built.
CodeRabbit CLI has a 150-file diff limit; large phase diffs (179 files) must be split into directory-scoped review passes.
apps/web/public/recovery.html (untouched since Phase 24) only accepts legacy v2 vault blobs while the app has produced v3/node-v3 since Phase 62 — a known architectural gap, not a regression.

code.finding: moveItem re-homes the moved child's WriteChildRef from source to dest write-body (unseal under source writeKey, drop from source, reseal under dest writeKey keyed by childPub.id UUID at destEntry.generation, dest-before-source publish order preserved) — added in 68.1-31 to fix a real user-reported bug where editing a file after moving it into a subfolder threw 'not write-capable (no WriteChildRef)'.

updateSharedSingleFile added (68.1-32) as a new write seam for direct single-file shares, which lack the parent folder write-body context the folder-based updateSharedFile requires; unwraps readDescriptorRef/writeDescriptorRef, unsealNode, targets the file's own IPNS at seq+1.

subscribeToSdk handler does hybrid projection: synchronous insert when all children's kinds are already cached, else awaits resolveKinds with a stale-sequence guard — fixes the D-02 kind-cache race without disturbing the 68.1-26 empty-over-non-empty guard (lines ~216-237).

dfsFindFolder in client.ts (not this file) was found to unconditionally re-resolve and overwrite already-loaded ancestor folderTree entries on every descent, causing breadcrumb-up empty-flash; fixed with a cache short-circuit for already write-capable entries (68.1-26).

workflow: Long-running background e2e suites launched by subagents repeatedly suffer 'lost wake' — the agent parks waiting on its own background task but is never re-notified and its session/transcript can get evicted; mitigate with an independent disk-based watchdog plus prompt-based SendMessage resume while the transcript is still warm, and fall back to a fresh continuation agent with explicit completed_state when evicted.

Human-verify checkpoints on autonomous:false plans must never self-approve — the exit-gate agent correctly returned to the user for explicit sign-off multiple times (round 2 deferrals, GAP-6 decision, 10.3/10.4 fixes) rather than silently absorbing failures into a passing score.

Session/quota limits can kill an agent mid-task after it already wrote artifacts to disk (a plan file, partial commits) — recovery protocol is to spot-check disk state, validate structure inline, commit what's salvageable, and resume rather than restart from scratch.

Live manual QA by the user caught three real bugs the automated e2e suite structurally could not reach due to serial-abort cascading and never-executed deep test sections (cold-reload subfolder nav, text-editor decryption-failed, move-then-edit write-capability) — 'suite green' does not mean 'every path exercised.'

When re-running only a subset of e2e specs to confirm a fix, order-dependent test interactions can still hide (full-workflow 3.9 passed in isolation but failed in the full suite until a genuine spec race condition was found and fixed) — isolated-pass is not sufficient proof; a full suite re-run at the fixed HEAD is needed for a corroborated verification artifact.
gsd-tools subcommand names can be non-obvious/renamed (tdd-gate doesn't exist; correct is tdd-review-checkpoint) — worth checking help/reference docs rather than guessing.

friction: Exit-gate agents launching long background e2e runs repeatedly lost their wake signal and had to be manually resumed via SendMessage, costing significant wall-clock time across multiple rounds.
CodeRabbit CLI's 150-file limit forced ad hoc directory-scoped splitting of the review for this large phase diff.

Two separate subagents violated the 'never git stash' rule mid-execution; both self-caught and recovered without data loss, but required manual verification that the user's own pre-existing stashes were untouched.
1Password git commit signing produces false-negative timeouts/failures requiring manual git log verification instead of blind retries, adding overhead to nearly every commit-heavy step.
SDK E2E gate revealed 89 skipped tests (7/10 fail when force-enabled) — quarantined suites need real v3 rework, discovered only when probing during the ship-phase gate, not earlier.
Playwright wipes test-results/ on each run and this config produces no usable .last-run.json, breaking the stat-based watchdog approach and forcing manual failure-artifact harvesting between runs.
Wrong cwd (a stuck `cd docker`) caused a false 'ROADMAP.md missing' scare mid-session.

rotation-durability SC-4: API's DB-canonical resolve makes the relay-replay simulation unreachable — needs an apps/api architectural decision or test redesign — deferred, approved by user.
restore-to-different-parent write re-homing — same bug class as the move fix (68.1-31) but for bin-restore-to-different-parent, which is not a currently shipped flow — documented, unfixed.
Re-enable/fix quarantined sdk-e2e suites for v3 (7/10 fail when un-skipped) — captured as a todo during ship-phase SDK E2E gate.

Six simplify-review findings captured as todos: dedupe SDK write-plane helpers, consolidate web shared-navigation duplication, hoist base64ToBytes into crypto package, remove legacy moveInSharedFolder share_keys branch, drop discarded per-upload ECIES wrapKey, download-progress UX decision for useFileDownload.
Codebase drift is warn-only at 143 structural elements since last mapping — /gsd-map-codebase refresh recommended but not run.
